- Spectrum: tap to place a marker showing its frequency and level, with a "Listen here" button that opens the Listen tool tuned there, in the mode its band uses
- Spectrum: the header shows the range of the radio plugged in instead of the HackRF's
- Listen: the "Auto" step in AM follows the broadcast spacing, 9 kHz on long and medium wave and 5 kHz on shortwave
- Listen: the passband shadow now shows in USB and LSB, on the right side of the carrier
- SDR settings: converter offset for an up- or down-converter (Ham It Up, SpyVerter or any value); the tools keep showing the real frequency
- Frequency fields show an antenna icon
